title: The Triple Hoop
metaDescription: Three diamond hoops, collet-set with round brilliant diamonds. 5.32 carats total. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Three hoops, each set with round brilliant diamonds in individual collet mounts — eighteen stones in total, 5.32 carats, each diamond seated alone so the light enters from every direction. The collet, the oldest setting form in fine jewellery, holds the stone precisely without obscuring it — used eighteen times in sequence, across three continuous arcs that move as one piece on the ear.

specs.label: Gem Stones
specs.body: 18 round brilliant diamonds · 5.32 carats total · approximately 0.30 carats each · collet set · Clarity VS.

specs.label: Metal
specs.body: Available in 18K white gold, yellow gold, or rose gold. Also in platinum.

specs.label: Size
specs.body: Three-hoop drop earring. Available by request in adjusted hoop diameters to fit the wearer.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Each piece is inspected stone by stone before delivery. Available by private appointment.
